_comment: Hand-maintained facts for /gta-6/ ('Does GTA 6 have mods?'). Every fact needs a primary or clearly attributed source. pc_release.status is 'not-announced', 'announced' (date set by Rockstar) or 'released'. The countdown on the page appears ONLY when status is 'announced' and date is an official Rockstar date (YYYY-MM-DD); reported/rumoured windows go in 'reported' and are never counted down. When Rockstar announces a PC date: set status, date, date_source (the Newswire URL) and bump last_verified. When the PC version ships, ModSafe can start tracking it like GTA V. HOME PAGE (owner's request, 2026-11-21): once status is 'announced' (or 'released'), the home hero gets a GTA 6 button with the date, and its background switches from Cyberpunk to static/img/gta-6-hero.webp IF that file exists. Add that art only from the same source as other games' art (GTA VI's Steam store CDN library_hero, cropped/converted like the others), never from fan sites.

console_release.source_title: Rockstar Newswire: Grand Theft Auto VI is now set to launch November 19, 2026

pc_release.official_note: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick declined to discuss a PC version on the November 2026 earnings call and said platform news will come from Rockstar.

reported.by: GamesBeat, citing anonymous industry sources (Oct 13, 2026; updated Nov 18). Rockstar has not commented.
reported.source_title: VideoCardz: GTA VI PC release reportedly planned for Q1 2027 (summarising GamesBeat)
